create_channel_ready_future: create a future that tracks when a gRPC channel becomes ready using channel_ready_future
cancel_channel_ready_future: cancel a ChannelReadyFuture to unsubscribe from channel connectivity updates without closing the channel
add_done_callback_to_future: add a done callback function to a ChannelReadyFuture that fires when the channel is ready
check_channel_future_state: check if a ChannelReadyFuture is running, done, or cancelled using the state query methods
wait_for_channel_result: wait for a ChannelReadyFuture result with an optional timeout to block until the channel is ready
